versions.content: The API Dem_SetEnableCondition shall trigger the callback function InitMonitorForEvent of the related event(s) in case an enable condition of the event(s) is changed to fulfilled and thus all enable conditions of the event(s) are fulfilled. The InitMonitorReason parameter shall be set to DEM_INIT_MONITOR_- REENABLED .
